Script.name: StaticChaos Mapper
Script.script:
-- StaticChaos GMCP auto-mapper. -- Consumes the server's Room.Info ({num,name,area,exits}) and populates -- Mudlet's built-in mapper, placing each new room next to the one you came -- from. Open the map with the Mapper toolbar button to watch it draw.
scMap = scMap or {}
-- our exit dir -> (dx,dy,dz) and Mudlet's direction word scMap.delta = { n = {0, 1, 0}, s = {0, -1, 0}, e = {1, 0, 0}, w = {-1, 0, 0}, u = {0, 0, 1}, d = {0, 0, -1}, } scMap.dirword = { n = "n", s = "s", e = "e", w = "w", u = "up", d = "down" }
local function trim(str) str = str or "" str = str:gsub("^%s+", "") str = str:gsub("%s+$", "") return str end
function scMap.area(name) name = trim(name) if name == "" then name = "Unknown" end local areas = getAreaTable() or {} if areas[name] then return areas[name] end return addAreaName(name) end
function scMap.onRoom() local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not r or r.num == nil then return end local vnum = tonumber(r.num) if not vnum then return end
local isNew = not roomExists(vnum) if isNew then addRoom(vnum) end
setRoomName(vnum, r.name or ("Room " .. vnum)) setRoomArea(vnum, scMap.area(r.area))
-- place a freshly-seen room next to wherever we walked from if isNew then local x, y, z = 0, 0, 0 if scMap.lastVnum and scMap.lastExits and roomExists(scMap.lastVnum) then for dir, target in pairs(scMap.lastExits) do if tonumber(target) == vnum and scMap.delta[dir] then local px, py, pz = getRoomCoordinates(scMap.lastVnum) local dlt = scMap.delta[dir] x = (px or 0) + dlt[1]; y = (py or 0) + dlt[2]; z = (pz or 0) + dlt[3] break end end end setRoomCoordinates(vnum, x, y, z) end
-- exits: connect to rooms we already know, stub the rest if type(r.exits) == "table" then for dir, target in pairs(r.exits) do local word = scMap.dirword[dir] local t = tonumber(target) if word then if t and roomExists(t) then setExit(vnum, t, word) else setExitStub(vnum, word, true) end end end end
scMap.lastVnum = vnum scMap.lastExits = r.exits centerview(vnum) updateMap() end
if scMap.handler then killAnonymousEventHandler(scMap.handler) end scMap.handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", "scMap.onRoom")
